transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I’m here because I keep getting stuck on this thought… like, even after I’ve checked the cab, I still feel like I missed something. Like someone could get hurt, or my boss will think I lied about checking it. It keeps coming back while I’m driving, and even when I try to study. I can’t really shut it off.
Do you find yourself doing anything over and over to try to make these thoughts go away or to prevent the bad things you're worried about from happening?

Yeah… I do. Before I take a ride, I’ll check the car. Tires, lights, doors, the meter, papers… stuff like that.

But I don’t just do it once. I keep going around again, and sometimes I take pictures. If it doesn’t feel right, I start over. Even if someone’s waiting or I’m already late.
Do you feel anxious when you're unable to perform your checking rituals?

Yeah… I get really tense if I can’t do it. Like before a ride, I need to go around the car checking the tires, lights, doors, meter, papers… and if I can’t, or if it doesn’t feel right, I keep thinking I missed something. Sometimes I take pictures or start over, even if people are waiting.
Do you worry about things other than the safety of your passengers or the condition of the cab?
I don’t know… not really. It’s mostly the cab stuff, I think. I haven’t really noticed other things like that.
Are these thoughts and checking rituals affecting your relationships or work as a cab driver?

Yeah… it’s been causing problems.

I’ve lost rides because I can’t get on the road fast enough, and I’ve gotten warnings for it. My CDL studying keeps getting pushed back too, because a lot of the day gets eaten up with checking.

And… I don’t really see my friends much anymore. I’m usually behind on work or trying to catch up after I wasted time.
Do you think these thoughts and checking rituals are reasonable, or do they seem excessive or irrational to you?

I mean… part of me knows it’s too much. Like, checking the tires and lights once makes sense, but I keep going around again and again, doors, meter, papers… sometimes taking pictures or starting the whole thing over if it feels wrong.

So yeah, I guess it’s excessive. I just don’t feel okay stopping, even when people are waiting and I’m already late.
How distressing are these thoughts and checking rituals to you on a daily basis?

Pretty distressing… most days.

It’s like, even after I know I checked, the thought comes back that I missed something on the cab and someone could get hurt, or my boss will think I lied about checking it. I can’t really shut it off, even when I’m driving or trying to study.
Are there any other areas of your life, besides work and friendships, that you feel are being affected by these thoughts and checking rituals?

Mostly it’s the same stuff… work, school stuff, friends.

I mean, the CDL studying is a big one. I keep meaning to do it, but then I’m late from checking and the day’s already messed up. And I don’t really see people much because I’m either behind on rides or trying to catch up. So… yeah, it kind of takes over more than I want to admit.
Do you often feel anxious or on edge when you're not thinking about the cab or driving?

I don’t know… not really, I guess.

Most of it is tied to the cab stuff. If I’m not thinking about that, I’m usually just… okay, or distracted. I haven’t really noticed being on edge for no reason.
Do you feel anxious when you're not thinking about work or the cab, like when you're relaxing or doing something you enjoy?
Not really… I mean, if I’m actually doing something else, I don’t think I’m anxious. I haven’t noticed it much outside of the work stuff.
Do you often feel anxious when you're doing things you enjoy, like hobbies or spending time with family?
Um… I don’t think so. I mean, I haven’t really noticed feeling anxious during that kind of stuff. If I’m distracted, I’m usually just… distracted.
Is your anxiety only present when you're thinking about the cab or is it also there at other times?

It’s mostly when I start thinking about the cab. Like… even if I know I checked it, I get this thought that I missed something and someone could get hurt, or my boss will think I lied. Then it’s hard to shut off, especially when I’m driving or trying to study.
Do you ever feel anxious when you're not thinking about work or the cab and there's no apparent reason for it?
I don’t think so… not that I’ve really noticed. It usually seems tied to those thoughts, not just out of nowhere.
Do you ever feel anxious in situations that have nothing to do with your work as a cab driver?

Not really… it’s mainly that cab thing. Like even after I’ve checked it, I keep thinking I missed something and someone could get hurt, or my boss will think I lied. It gets stuck in my head when I’m driving or trying to study.
Do you feel anxious in social situations, like when you're meeting new people?
Not really… I mean, I can be quiet around new people, but I don’t think I get anxious like that.
Do you feel like your anxiety is only about the cab and your work, or is it something that affects you more broadly in life?

I think it’s mostly the cab and work. Like… I came in because even after I know I did the safety check, I keep getting hit with the thought that I missed something, and someone could get hurt, or my boss will think I lied. It just won’t really shut off when I’m driving or trying to study.
Do you feel anxious when you are in a completely different environment, away from work and the cab?
I don’t really know… I haven’t noticed it much when I’m away from the cab. It’s not something I usually think about, I guess.
Do you often feel anxious when you're not thinking about work or the cab and there's no apparent reason for it?
I’m not sure… I don’t think so. If I’m not thinking about that stuff, I don’t really notice anxiety coming up for no reason.
Is there ever a time when you feel anxious and it has nothing to do with the cab or your work as a driver?
Not really… I mean, I can’t think of a time like that. It usually ties back to the cab or work somehow.
Is there anything else that triggers your anxiety besides the thoughts about the cab and your work as a driver?

Not really anything else… it’s mostly that thought, like even after I checked the cab, I start thinking maybe I missed something and someone could get hurt, or my boss will think I lied. It kind of sticks in my head when I’m driving… or even trying to study.
